text.jp: ……まぁ……そうだな。
text.official_en: Yeah...you could say that.

text.jp: 「ジ・ン・セ・イ・の」、先輩でしょ？
text.official_en: But I <text style="italic">am</> your senior in <text style="italic">life</>.
text.real_en: I mean, I'm your senior in <text style="italic">life</>, right?

text.jp: ああ、そうだけど。
text.official_en: I am. What about it?
text.real_en: Yeah, I am.

text.jp:
あれ？
キミってグランシェルトの騎士じゃない？
text.official_en: Wait a minute, are you a knight of Grandshelt?

text.jp: いや……そういうわけじゃないけど……
text.official_en: Uh, no... Not really.

text.jp:
ええ。
私の調査によると、エルフは雷鳴山にいた時代も
あったようなの。
text.official_en: There is. According to my research, at some point in time elves lived on Mt. Thunderclap.

text.jp: ええ？　自分で調べたらいいじゃないか。
text.official_en: What? Why can’t you do it yourself?
text.real_en: Huh? Why don't you look into it yourself?

text.jp:
え？
シルヴィアなんて先輩、いなかったような……
text.official_en: Huh? I don’t remember any senior knight named Silvia...
text.real_en: Huh? I don't remember any senior named Silvia...

text.jp: さっすが後輩クン！
text.official_en: Yes! I knew I could count on you!
text.real_en: Just what I'd expect from Kouhai-kun!

text.jp: じゃ、先輩とは呼べないな。
text.official_en: So... You’re <text style="italic">not</> a knight. Let alone my senior.
text.real_en: Then I can't exactly call you my senior.

text.jp:
じゃあ、私の後輩クンね！
よろしく！　私はシルヴィアよ。
text.official_en: Well, that makes me your senior knight! Well met! I’m Silvia.
text.real_en:
So you're my Kouhai-kun!
Good to meet you! I'm Silvia.

text.jp:
そうね～。
堅苦しいのが合わなさそうでさ。
あと、どうしてもやりたいことができちゃって。
text.official_en: Weeell... I figured I’m not cut out for the life of a knight—it’s too suffocating. Besides, I found my true calling.
text.real_en: Well... All that rigid formality just didn't suit me. Besides, there was something I really wanted to do.

text.jp:
そもそも「ミシディア」自体が
おとぎ話でしか聞いたことないじゃない？
text.official_en: Mysidia itself is something out of a fairy tale too.
text.real_en: Even Mysidia itself is something we've only heard of in fairy tales, right?

text.jp:
そりゃそうよ。
私は騎士団に入る直前でやめちゃったから。
text.official_en: Well, yeah. I quit right before I officially joined the Order.

text.jp:
それで、もう一つの手がかりである
ディルナド大陸にきてみたってわけ。
text.official_en: That’s why I came to Dirnado, trailing another clue about the elves.
text.real_en: That's why I came to the continent of Dirnado, following another clue.

text.jp: だから、先輩じゃないって……
text.official_en: I already told you, you’re not my senior knight...
text.real_en: I've told you, you're not my senior...

text.jp:
でしょ？
だから、エルフの戦い方について学びたくてね。
今はそれであちこちを旅しているの。
text.official_en: I know, right? That’s why I want to learn about elven martial arts. I’ve been traveling all over the place in search of them.
text.real_en: Right? That's why I want to learn how elves fought. I've been traveling around to find out.

text.jp:
でも、どうして入団の直前でやめたんだ？
試験は受かったってことだよな。
text.official_en: Why did you quit before you joined anyway? I’m assuming you passed the initiation, right?
text.real_en: But why did you quit right before joining? You passed the exam, right?

text.jp:
とっても古い伝承にだけ残っている
魔法の扱いに長けた種族……
text.official_en: They’re a race well-versed in the use of magic, and only referred to in old, <text style="italic">old</> legends.
text.real_en: A race skilled in magic, mentioned only in very old legends...

text.jp: どうしたの？　キミも探し物？
text.official_en: Everything okay? Are you looking for something as well?
text.real_en: What's up? Looking for something too?

text.jp: なんだかカッコいいな。
text.official_en: They...actually sound awesome.

text.jp:
ねぇねぇ、ものは相談なんだけど、
手がかりを探してきてくれない？
text.official_en: Sooo...I know we just met and you might say nooo...but I’ll ask anyway: can you find me evidence of elves there?
text.real_en: Hey, could I ask you a favor? Would you look for some clues for me?

text.jp:
はぁ……仕方ないな。
わかったよ。
text.official_en: ...Okay...fine... I’ll go and see if I can find any evidence of these elves.
text.real_en: Sigh... I guess I have no choice. All right.

text.jp:
ふむふむ……。
そう簡単に情報は手に入らないかぁ……。
text.official_en: Hmm... Not like I’ll find it just posted here...
text.real_en: Hmm... So getting information isn't going to be that easy...

text.jp:
むむ、意外と細かいわねぇ……。
いいじゃない、ちょっとくらい……。
text.official_en: Oh pshaw, you’re splitting hairs...work with me here a little, will you?
text.real_en: Oh, you're surprisingly picky... Come on, just a little...

text.jp:
もしかして後輩クン、
先輩のお願いが聞けないっていうの？
text.official_en: So you’re not going to help out your favorite senior knight?
text.real_en:
What, Kouhai-kun?
You won't do your senpai a favor?

text.jp: やっぱり、知らないか。
text.official_en: I take it you don’t. I don’t blame you.
text.real_en: So you haven't heard of them, huh.

text.jp: エルフとディルナドになにか関係が？
text.official_en: There’s something that connects the elves to Dirnado?

text.jp: エルフは木や草に痕跡を残す習慣があるみたいなの。
text.official_en: It’s supposedly an elven custom to leave marks on trees and grass.

text.jp: エルフ？
text.official_en: Elves?

text.jp:
噂では、「魔道都市ミシディア」にいた
とも言われているけど……。
text.official_en: Rumor has it that they existed in Mysidia, the magiapolis, but...
text.real_en: Rumor has it they once lived in the magical city of Mysidia, but...

text.jp:
彼らは、自然と調和し、魔法を自由に使いこなし、
剣で舞うように戦った……なんて記述もあるの。
text.official_en: To quote a source, they “attuned to the nature around them, wielded magic as naturally as they breathed, and flourished blades as if they were dancing.”
text.real_en: Some accounts say they lived in harmony with nature, wielded magic freely, and fought with swords as if they were dancing...

text.jp: 後輩クンは、エルフって知っている？
text.official_en: You know of elves, young knight?
text.real_en: Hey, Kouhai-kun, have you heard of elves?

text.jp:
私の調べによると
エルフたちは、特殊な戦い方をしていたみたいなのよね。
text.official_en: According to my research, they apparently fought battles using very particular techniques.

text.jp:
私は調査のために
しばらくディルマギアにいたいのよ。
text.official_en: I need to be in Dilmagia for a while for my research.
text.real_en: I want to stay in Dilmagia for a while to do some research.

text.jp:
雷鳴山にいったら
ちょーっと変わった草木がないか、見てみて。
お願いね！
text.official_en: So when you go to Mt. Thunderclap, be sure to keep a lookout for any vegetation that looks a <text style="italic">taaad</> bit off. Good hunting!
text.real_en: When you get to Mt. Thunderclap, see if you can spot any trees or plants that look just a <text style="italic">little</> unusual, okay?

text.jp:
（この人……熱心に掲示板を眺めているなぁ
何か探し物でもしているのかな……）
text.official_en: (She’s taking a <text style="italic">really</> good look at that noticeboard. Wonder if she lost something?)
text.real_en: (She's studying that noticeboard <text style="italic">really</> intently... I wonder if she's looking for something.)
